warnings: Every `description_prose_unverified` field is the game's own prose and is NOT reliable. Where prose and columns disagree, the columns are what the tick actually does. Three known contradictions are flagged inline with a `description_warning` field.

`satisfaction_on_build` (a one-time payout when you build) and `satisfaction_per_tick` (an ongoing effect) are stored in the same-named column of two different tables. They are not the same number and are not interchangeable.
`build_requires_owned` lists prerequisites that are checked but NOT consumed. Only `build_consumes` is spent.
`money_cost_przewalskia` is null where Przewalskia cannot build the thing at all. The raw table stores 0 there, which does not mean free.
Dropped orphan recipeitems rows for recipe_id(s) 39: they have cost rows but no matching recipe, so they are unbuildable dead data.

buildings.name: Advanced Factory
buildings.description_prose_unverified: This factory makes precision parts and composites.

built_by.description_prose_unverified: For 50 copper, 50 energy, 20 machinery parts, and 20 vehicle parts, you make a factory that uses 2 energy per tick (and -1 satisfaction a tick) to generate 20k GDP and allows for the creation of precision parts and composites. Build more than 5 and the environmentalists get on your ass. However, it's a large enough achievement that you get 20 satisfaction for building it.

buildings.name: Alicornification Facility
buildings.description_prose_unverified: You know what this does.

buildings.name: Bakery
buildings.description_prose_unverified: Every turn, this bakery performs the vital task of turning 1 unit of energy and 2 of apples into 3 huge boxes of pies. It's also a great place to work.

built_by.description_prose_unverified: Far more efficient than distributing apples directly, the bakery uses 1 energy and 2 apples to make 3 boxes of pies and add 1 satisfaction every tick. Ponies become more satisfied by 2 just watching it be built. Needs 5 copper, 5 energy, 5 vehicle parts, and 5 machinery parts to build.

buildings.name: Bar
buildings.description_prose_unverified: Unlike bars for humans, this one serves pies with its cider. Uses 3 coffee and 1 pie a turn to provide your ponies with 10 satisfaction. No energy is required.

built_by.description_prose_unverified: Use 40 copper to construct a bar that uses up 3 cider and 1 pie a tick to increase your ponies' satisfaction by 10. Raises satisfaction by 5 just being built.

buildings.name: Barracks
buildings.description_prose_unverified: For 500 copper, 500 energy, 50 vehicle parts, and 50 machinery parts, you build a Barracks that increases your new forces' training by 1. More Barracks stack. However, building more than 1 Barracks very much worries your little ponies.

built_by.description_prose_unverified: For 4 million bits, 500 copper, 500 energy, 50 vehicle parts, and 50 machinery parts, you build a Barracks that increases your new forces' training by 1. buildings.name: Basic Apple Orchard
buildings.description_prose_unverified: Growing apple according to the local climate, this Apple Orchard produces 5 units of raw apples every 2 hours. It uses nothing but pure horsepower, making it a backbreaking place to work for the local horses.

built_by.description_prose_unverified: Plow a basic apple-growing orchard that uses only horsepower and no modern equipment for -2 sat and 5 apples a tick. Building more than 10 hurts the environment.
built_by.przewalskia_note: Przewalskia cannot build this at all -- it is locked to Burrozil.

buildings.name: Basic Copper Mine
buildings.description_prose_unverified: A nasty and downright dangerous place to work, this mine provides 5 units of copper every 2 hours.

built_by.description_prose_unverified: Your zebras will toil underground in the dark with no mechanical help (-2 sat) to get 5 copper every tick. Building more than 10 hurts the environment.
built_by.przewalskia_note: Przewalskia cannot build this at all -- it is locked to Zebrica.

buildings.name: Basic Factory
buildings.description_prose_unverified: Little more than a series of primitive CNC machines and some aging control systems, this factory makes everything from basic gun parts to pieces of more advanced factories. It's not the greatest place to work (-1 sat/turn), but on the bright side, it turns one unit of energy into 10k money every 2 hours, depending on your economy type. Building more than 20 hurts the environment.

built_by.description_prose_unverified: Using 12 energy and 30 copper, build a basic factory that turns 1 unit of energy into 10k money, depending on your economy type, every tick. It's not the greatest place to work (-1 sat/tick), but owning this factory lets you make other things with it. If you build more than 20, overindustrialization starts hurting the environment.

As part of an experimental joint development initiative, the Solar Empire and New Lunar Republic are building basic factories in new Przewalskian nations for only 100,000 bits. You can only receive one of these.

buildings.description_prose_unverified: Inefficient, dirty as hell, and a horrible place to work, this well provides 5 units of the black goo that runs the world every 2 hours.

buildings.name: Gasoline Combustion Facility
buildings.description_prose_unverified: This combustion facility burns oil to gasoline for no satisfaction loss.

buildings.name: Mall
buildings.description_prose_unverified: The Mall is the ultimate in satisfaction and revenue generation. It gives 400,000 (!) GDP and 50 satisfaction a turn. Raises satisfaction by 100 just being built- although if you're at the level where you can build this, you probably don't care.

Przewalskia.note: Produces none of the region-locked raw goods and can never build their extractors. In exchange it pays cost_przewalskia -- a much lower money cost -- on everything it can build. Hard mode.

ticks.war_tick_note: A war tick is an ordinary tick that also resolves combat. Military upkeep is charged ONLY on war ticks, forces only arrive on war ticks, and conquest only happens on a war tick. On non-war ticks armies do nothing and cost nothing.

production.modifiers: NONE. There is no tech, labor, or pollution scaling on output.
production.all_or_nothing: If ANY per-tick input is short for the WHOLE stack of a building type, the entire stack produces nothing that tick and you lose 1 satisfaction per building. It is not partial or pro-rata.
production.same_tick_note: Goods produced during a tick are written straight to the database and are NOT available to feed another building in that same tick.
production.disabled_note: Each disabled building costs 1 satisfaction per tick.

pollution.applies_when: bad_min is non-zero and effective_count > bad_min
pollution.per: Computed separately per building type, then summed.
pollution.mitigation: Total pollution across all building types is multiplied by 0.9 ** n, where n is the number of WORKING Solar/Lunar Environmental Facilities (they must have their 5 Energy per tick to count). The difference is refunded as satisfaction.

gdp.multiplier: Fixed per government where governments[g].gdp_multiplier is set; otherwise 1 + (satisfaction / 1000).
gdp.caveat: The in-game estimate in backend/allfunctions.php:113-117 sums gdp over ALL owned buildings regardless of whether their inputs are available, so it over-reports. Only working buildings actually pay out.

combat.crossed_indexing_warning: The attacker's weapon column is chosen by the DEFENDER's type, and the defender's armor column is chosen by the ATTACKER's type. Getting this backwards is the single easiest mistake to make here.
combat.armor_direction: arm_* is a damage MULTIPLIER. Lower is better.
combat.home_defence_bonus: Damage against a unit defending its own nation is multiplied by 0.75, unless that nation's owner is in stasis mode.
combat.casualties: floor(round(accumulated_damage, 6)); at or above `size` the force is destroyed.

unequipped_defaults.note: Weapon/armor id 0 is 'Scrounged'. PHP treats id 0 as falsy, so Scrounged gear takes these fallbacks rather than any table row.

combat.alicorns: Force type 6 is recast as type 5 (Naval) for targeting, with a flat dmg of 10 and arm of 0.1 against every type. Equipped weapons and armor are ignored entirely.
combat.training: National recruits arrive at training = min(Barracks owned, 20). Mercenaries arrive at training 10 and cost 2x-3x depending on relation.

market.order_book: marketplace = sell offers, buyermarketplace = standing bids. The unique key is (nation_id, resource_id, price), so one nation can hold several rows for the same good at different prices.
market.spread: The buyer pays price * buy_multiplier; the seller receives price * sell_multiplier. The difference is destroyed, not transferred.
market.buyer_limits: Minimum bid price 1000. Total outstanding bid value is capped at 200,000,000 + funds/10 for resources, 100,000,000 + funds/10 for gear.

stockpile_siphon.goods: Anything over 50,000 loses ceil((amount - 50000) / 500) per tick.
stockpile_siphon.equipment: Weapons/armor over 1,000 lose ceil((amount - 1000) / 500) per tick.

satisfaction_penalties.military_size: ceil((total force size - 20) / 2) if total size > 20
satisfaction_penalties.empire_size: (nations - 1) ** 2 * 20, divided by 3 under Oppression, Alicorn Elite, or Transponyism
satisfaction_penalties.death: Below -5000 satisfaction the nation is deleted into the graveyard.
satisfaction_penalties.rebels: Below a per-government threshold, rebels (nation_id -3) spawn with size ceil(-satisfaction / 4) minus a government bonus.
